playstyle.identity: Xin Zhao is a straightforward duelist who excels at diving single targets. His ultimate creates a safe zone that blocks projectiles from outside.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive heals every 3rd hit. Q empowers 3 autos, 3rd knocks up. W slashes then thrusts (thrust slows). E dashes to target and slows. R knocks back enemies and creates a zone - outside projectiles are blocked. E-Q-W combo to duel, R to isolate in teamfights.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Xin Zhao spikes early with dueling and at 6 with his isolation R. Eclipse or bruiser items work. He's strong at early ganks and 1v1s.

passive.name: Determination
passive.details: Every third attack heals Xin Zhao.

abilities.name: Three Talon Strike
abilities.summary: Empower next 3 attacks; third knocks up.
abilities.details: Xin Zhao empowers his next 3 auto attacks to deal bonus damage. The third attack knocks the target up.

abilities.name: Wind Becomes Lightning
abilities.summary: Slash, then thrust; thrust slows enemies.
abilities.details: Xin Zhao slashes in a cone, then thrusts forward. The thrust slows enemies and has higher range.

abilities.name: Audacious Charge
abilities.summary: Dash to an enemy, slowing them and nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Xin Zhao dashes to an enemy, dealing damage and slowing them and nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Crescent Guard
abilities.summary: Knock back enemies and create a zone that blocks outside projectiles.
abilities.details: Xin Zhao sweeps his spear, knocking back enemies (except the last one hit by abilities). He creates a zone around him that blocks all projectiles from outside.
